name: lysine acetyltransferase 8

function.text: KAT8 is the approved symbol for lysine acetyltransferase 8. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in enzyme binding; histone acetyltransferase activity; dosage compensation by inactivation of X chromosome.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Li-Ghorbani-Weisz-Hubshman syndrome (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
